Writing

Going in a completely new direction this time — quiet luxury, Aesop-adjacent, no icons, no decorations, just pure typography doing all the work.

Type: Tenor Sans (ultra-thin geometric) + Cormorant italic for accents
Palette: Warm linen white, near-black charcoal, single copper accent
Layout: Asymmetric hero, numbered feature list (not cards), extreme whitespace

Palette: Warm parchment #F7F3EE, near-black #181614, single copper oklch(62% 0.09 52) — one accent, used sparingly
